name: matlab-generate-5g-waveform
description: Generate 3GPP-compliant 5G NR downlink and uplink baseband waveforms. Use to create NR signals, test model (TM) waveforms, fixed reference channels (FRC), test and measurement (T&M) signals, or test vectors for conformance testing. Covers configuring data, control, and broadcast channels and signals: PDSCH, PUSCH, PDCCH, PUCCH, SRS, SSBurst, CSI-RS, DM-RS, PT-RS, CORESET, and BWP parameters including bandwidth, subcarrier spacing (SCS), modulation (QPSK, QAM), numerology, FR1, FR2, TDD, FDD, and multi-bandwidth-part setups. Use for signal generation, RF instrument playback, or IQ baseband synthesis. Requires 5G Toolbox.
